text:
maya: Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC staged release window. Affects API (v2.1.3), runtime (1.8.0-rc), console (ui-12 feature flag), router (schema v3). Can service owners confirm this interop and call out any blocking migrations?
andre: I'll own runtime readiness. Quick question: is the runtime RC pinned everywhere or only in eu regions?
sam: API will be pinned by default in the release. We have a migration for header-check -> header-v2, should be backward compatible but would like a small canary.
maya: plan is staged: router -> runtime -> api -> console. Router schema change first so runtime can pick up new headers.
lina: console team: ui-12 toggles are behind flag, no db changes. We'll wait for stable API traffic before turning on in prod.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks queued. Checks: healthchecks(runtime,api,router), schema-compat(router), canary-config(api). ETA ~10m.
andre: runtime health is green on canaries. One note: kv-eviction tweak in 1.8.0-rc could increase warmup latency. Recommend smaller initial canary (5%) and 2min steady window.
sam: OK 5% canary for API, 2min steady, rollback on >5% p50 latency regression or >1% error spike.
maya: agree. Also add header-mismatch metric to console dashboard for immediate rollback signal.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder: change window reserved 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager duty rotation set: @andre @maya on primary, @lina on secondary.
lina: noted. I'll hold the console toggle until api canary is healthy for 10m.
andre: starting runtime rollout to canary now. Tagging pin: runtime=1.8.0-rc+pin-r3
sam: API canary config:
```
canary: 5%
steady_window: 120s
rollback_triggers:
  - p50_latency_increase_pct: 5
  - error_rate_increase_pct: 1
```
maya: good. If any step fails, rollback sequence: console toggle off -> api redeploy previous -> runtime rollback to 1.7.9 -> router revert schema v2. Document the reason in release notes.
andre: runtime canary healthy at 5%. No evictions spike. Proceed to API canary.
sam: API canary healthy for 12m, p50 up +1.2% < threshold. No errors. Proceed to console toggle in staging then prod.
lina: toggled ui-12 in staging, looks fine. Will toggle in prod after 15m observation.
maya: final reminder: update release-notes channel with short bullet list after cutoff. Also tag release artifact: build/rls-2026-03-21-4302
sam: noted, I'll publish notes and pin the API version in the deployment manifest.
maya: thanks team. Will monitor for 45m then close window. :thumbsup:
